fact: The author states INE published partial poverty data in October 2024 (extreme poverty 2.28% in 2023 against 4.56% in 2015), while the definitive results of the IV IDRF, begun in December 2022, remain unpublished after more than three years; the criticism is of partial, inconsistent releases.
The World Bank's WDI lists 2021 as the latest population census for Cabo Verde.
The World Bank's WDI lists the STEPwise Survey for Non Communicable Diseases Risk Factors 2007 as the latest demographic, education or health household survey for Cabo Verde.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Income survey, 2015, as the source of the most recent income and expenditure data for Cabo Verde.
The World Bank's SPI lists population censuses for Cabo Verde in 2000, 2010 and 2021 within its scoring window; the latest year is used.
